title: 的 / 地 / 得 Step 2 · After the Verb: 得 = How Well, How Much
description: 得 looks back at the verb and comments on it: 跑得很快, 说得很好, 累得不想动. Plus the verb-copy trick with objects, and the other two 得s (děi, dé).

points.title: Verb + 得 + comment
points.summary: 得 comes **after** a verb (or adjective) and says how well, how much, or with what result.
points.body:
- 他跑**得**很快。 He runs fast.
- 她唱**得**很好听。 She sings beautifully.
- 我累**得**不想说话。 I'm so tired I don't want to talk.
- Negative: 跑**得不**快 (不 after 得).

⚠️ 得 is also read **děi** (must: 我得走了) and **dé** (get: 得了第一名).

| | comes before … | pattern | example |
|---|---|---|---|
| **的** | a **noun** | describer + 的 + noun | 漂亮**的**衣服 · 我买**的**书 |
| **地** | a **verb** (how it's done) | describer + 地 + verb | 慢慢**地**走 · 认真**地**学习 |
| **得** | the **result** (after the verb) | verb / adj. + 得 + how | 跑**得**很快 · 累**得**不想动 |

**The trick:** look **right** — a noun next → 的, a verb next → 地. Look **left** — a verb or adjective just before → 得. (All three are read *de*.)

points.title: With an object: say the verb twice
points.summary: If the verb has an object, repeat the verb — or move the object to the front.
points.body:
- 他**说**中文**说得**很好。 ✔
- 他中文**说得**很好。 ✔ (object first)
- ~~他说中文得很好~~ ✘ — 得 must follow a verb directly.
- ~~他说得中文很好~~ ✘ — nothing goes between 得 and the comment.

| | comes before … | pattern | example |
|---|---|---|---|
| **的** | a **noun** | describer + 的 + noun | 漂亮**的**衣服 · 我买**的**书 |
| **地** | a **verb** (how it's done) | describer + 地 + verb | 慢慢**地**走 · 认真**地**学习 |
| **得** | the **result** (after the verb) | verb / adj. + 得 + how | 跑**得**很快 · 累**得**不想动 |

**The trick:** look **right** — a noun next → 的, a verb next → 地. Look **left** — a verb or adjective just before → 得. (All three are read *de*.)

notes: That'd be 他很快地跑了 — 地 + verb.
'Has to' is 得 **děi** — and it comes before the verb: 他得跑.
Nothing about the future here.

questions.prompt: 地 or 得? Before the verb, or after it?
questions.explanation: **地 + verb** (how you do it) · **verb + 得** (how it turned out).
notes: After 说 → 得.
After the verb 跑 → 得.
After 唱 → 得.
Before 听 → 地.
Before 唱 → 地.
Before the verb 跑 → 地.

questions.explanation: 她**唱得非常好**。 Verb + 得 + comment.

questions.prompt: Build it: 'He speaks Chinese very fluently.'
questions.explanation: 他**中文说得**很流利。 The object goes in front, so 得 can sit right after 说.

questions.prompt: Which say 'He writes characters beautifully'? Select all.
questions.explanation: Verb + object + **verb + 得** …, or object first.
notes: 'His characters are written beautifully.' ✔
Nothing can stand between 得 and the comment.
Object in front: 字写得很漂亮. ✔
Verb copied: 写字**写得**很漂亮. ✔
得 must follow a **verb**, not the object: repeat 写.

questions.explanation: 得 before a verb is **děi** = must, have to.
notes: 得 *děi* = must.
That would be 我走得很好 — 得 *de* after the verb.
'Can' is 能 / 会.

options: {跑|pǎo}{得|de}{满头大汗|mǎn tóu dà hàn}
notes: The 不 belongs after 得: 跑得不快.
No 了 between 得 and the comment.
✔ result: ran till he was dripping with sweat.
✔ negative: 不 goes **after** 得.
✔ how fast.

questions.prompt: 得 does more than 'how well'. Match each sentence to what 得 does.
questions.explanation: Verb + 得 + comment / result / possible (得懂, 得完).
notes: Laughed so much their bellies hurt.
So tired that I don't want to talk.
How fast she runs.
听得懂 = can understand (听不懂 = can't).
How well he speaks.
吃得完 = able to finish.

questions.explanation: 游泳 is verb + object → 游泳**游得**很快.
notes: 游泳 = 游 (verb) + 泳 (object) — copy the verb: 游泳**游得**.
Before a verb it would be 地 — and that means something else.
The object can't sit after 得.
